mapper.select: SELECT sync_batch_id, connection_id, sync_status, requested_at, completed_at, error_message FROM account_sync_batches WHERE connection_id = #{connectionId} ORDER BY requested_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_sync_batches (connection_id, sync_status, requested_at) VALUES (#{connectionId}, 'REQUESTED', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
